scope: Full fixed core medium-fi exterior, with explicitly approximate hidden detail.

quallaSearch.notes: Qualla imagery was checked first; useful present exterior originals require attribution and are excluded. Exact named-creator Ownwork/CC0 originals by Romainbehar, DimiTalen and Julian Lupyan now show the detailed belfry crown, near-whole tower and representative Cloth Hall/entrance-annex elevation. Neighboring cathedral, modern Stadshal beams, Christmas carousel and stalls are excluded.

originalReview.notes: Exact2552x3940native inspected: detailed gold clock ring, pointed belfry arch, four corner turrets, steep slate crown, dormers, ornate upper crown and gold dragon; lower tower cropped.
Exact1946x2927native inspected: near-full tower/belfry roof hierarchy; lower front obstructed by carousel. Carousel/people/stalls and adjacent church excluded.

Exact5854x3764native inspected: representative Cloth Hall roof/dormers/window pairs/corner turret and curved annex gable. Foreground modern pavilion masks outer extent and is excluded. Explicit self declaration plus cczero dedication belongs to named own-work photographer.
